notes: The holdout window starts on the next UTC date after the freeze cutoff.
The default evaluation window is fixed at 60 full UTC days to avoid cherry-picking the end date.
Preliminary evaluation is disabled by default even after 30 days; progress can be observed but promotion decisions wait for the full target window.
Strategy payload, execution assumptions, symbols and timeframes are frozen before any holdout candle is observed.
A passing holdout is still research evidence, not permission for live execution.
